changes: Bound owner Supabase control requests to 8s and visual-health requests to 5s with AbortController-backed timeout handling.
Restored #pair=<64-hex-token> parsing and one-time paired-device acceptance UI; pairing fragment is stripped after acceptance by existing code.
Versioned direct ES-module dependencies so a fresh HTML build cannot silently reuse stale semantic/network modules.
Added a narrowly scoped owner app-shell service worker for /hbnf-cart.html only, network-first with bounded fallback.
Service worker caches only same-origin GET app-shell/assets; control/API/device traffic is explicitly outside its fetch/cache path.
Added online/offline UI resync messaging and a permanent host regression for deadline, pairing, cache isolation and package closure.
Updated controller-only and coordinated-release packaging contracts to include the new reliability assets/tests.

validation.inherited_unchanged_scoring_validation: V7.3 owner scoring/auth/concurrency/uncertain-save tests remain applicable; scoring/backend source was not changed by this lane.

not_proven: Offline app-shell availability is not the same as offline control mutation; current canonical command transport still targets the Supabase relay.
No intended-owner-device Safari/Home Screen service-worker lifecycle or control/scoring smoke has been run.
exact_dependencies: P2_INTERFACE_FREEZE / legal Phase 2 authorization must define/freeze the local-control versus remote-relay transport boundary before offline mutation transport is implemented or deployed.

After legal T3 entry, deploy with rollback available and run intended-owner-device smoke: first online load/install, Home Screen relaunch, temporary WAN-loss shell behavior, reconnect/resync, paired authoritative scoring, and confirmed cart-control state.
